'''Ikis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave trader]] who served aboard captain [[Onyx (individual)|Onyx's]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] as a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the vessel was attacked by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], he managed to repair the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], after it was disabled by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], but was captured with the rest of the crew later.
